text: {"subject":"Claim C020294 (PT0061): request authorization increase on AUTH10768 before submission","body":"Claim C020294 for patient PT0061 (date of service 2026-10-14, code T1019) bills 20 units, but authorization AUTH10768 shows only 6 of 52 units remaining.
